messages:
Sam: late-shift check-in — quick update
Sam: What I did: patched inference node-45 (cuda driver), drained and reprovisioned. Observed 4 spot evictions in apac3 ~01:10 UTC. Moved canary to eu-west-1.
Sam: Blockers: APAC prewarm quota bump still in cloud ticket, request #INC-512 not approved. If prewarm stays low we might see queue surge.
Maya: thx Sam. Can you paste node drain logs? :eyes: 
Sam: log snippet:
```
2026-03-17T01:09:20Z node-45 spot-termination-signal
kubelet: drain initiated by ops
```
Sam: Also noticed elevated scheduling latency for 16GB jobs in apac3.
Lee: checked autoscaler metrics — it's hitting GPU-backed pod pending due to quota. We have 2 spare spot pools but they're saturated. Proposing a temporary prewarm bump.
Lee: I'll run: `infractl prewarm adjust --region apac3 --count 12 --expires 2h` and monitor.
Jordan: can we avoid spinning on-demand? maybe route low-priority traffic to apac2 (cheaper pool) while apac3 stabilizes.
Maya: agree. Sam can you update routing policy to prefer apac2 for low-priority? small lambda change should do it.
Sam: On it. Will push canary in ~10m: `git push origin ops/apac-routing && infractl rollout canary --route apac2-prefer`
Infra-bot: rollout started for ops/apac-routing by Sam. Canary group: 5% traffic.
Lee: nudged cloud ticket and DM'd acct manager (pinged @cloud-eng). :pray:
Jordan: FYI I added a temporary PD alert: apac3 pending-queue > 15 for 10m -> page on-call.
Maya: no other blockers from me. Leaving handoff notes in #ops-handoff. :thumbsup: 
Sam: thanks — I'll leave handoff and set reminder to scale back prewarm after 2h. Good night all.
Ops-rotation: next on-call: Jordan (00:30 UTC -> 08:30 UTC).
